description: Continuity-of-a-function drills: checking continuity of a plain formula at a point, checking/enforcing continuity of a piecewise function at the join point (often by finding an unknown parameter a/K/m so left-limit = right-limit = f(point)).

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 3: ភាពជាប់នៃអនុគមន៍ (Continuity of Functions) — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-28

exercises.technique: check_continuity_at_point: compute lim from each side (and f(point) if defined piecewise) and compare
find_parameter_for_continuity: set lim_{x\to c}f(x) equal to f(c) (or equal the other side's limit) and solve for the unknown constant, often via sinc/exponential/log standard limits
find_parameter_for_continuity, including multi-piece (3-branch) functions requiring continuity at two join points simultaneously
